acanthus-scroll-with-vase-and-satyr.description: Complete lower border of the recto. A grey acanthus scroll with gold-edged leaves runs the full width, curling at the left into a spiral that holds a red five-petalled flower. At the centre a copper-orange vase with a blue mouth sits on green acanthus leaves, with red and blue leaf tips on either side. At the right end a horned, bearded, goat-legged satyr with a brown body sits facing left and blows a long curved blue horn with red dots along its rim. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Initial E with Ornamental Border Containing a Seated Satyr and a Bird Eating Grapes (recto)

acanthus-scroll-with-vase-and-satyr.title: Acanthus scroll border with vase and horn-blowing satyr
usage_notes: Complete lower border about 3.3:1; the satyr sits at the right end, so keep the whole width or crop from the left spiral.
The vertical grapevine border and the thin leaf spindle come from the same page and frame text together with it.

blue-and-red-bud-with-two-green-leaves.description: A closed bud pointing left: two red petals with cream streaks and dots lie over a deep blue outer petal striped in white. The green stem curves off to the right and carries two broad green leaves with yellow veins, one above and one below. Black outlines; transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Ornamental Border with Pea Vines and a Girl Kneading Bread (recto)

blue-curled-flower-with-rose-lobes.description: A large blue flower at the upper left, its striped petals curling inward and one petal spiralling down to the left, with a brown and pale blue bract behind it, sits on a cluster of four rounded red lobes with cream striping. From the lower right a green stem carries two broad green leaves with pale veins and dark outlines, one pointing up and one down-left. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe at the edges; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Labors (recto)

blue-curled-flower-with-rose-lobes.quality: Ragged cut with a thin gold-ground fringe along the leaf and petal edges.
blue-curled-flower-with-rose-lobes.title: Blue curled flower with red lobes

blue-folded-flower-on-tall-green-stem.description: A deep blue flower with three folded, pale-striped petals and a long lower petal that curls down to the left, rising from a small green calyx of rounded sepals. A tall, slender green stem runs straight down with one pointed leaf on the right at mid height and one on the left near the foot, both with pale veins and dark outlines. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe at the edges; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Labors (recto)

blue-pointed-flower-on-upright-stem.description: An upright flower whose pointed blue outer petal rises to the upper left over three dusky rose inner petals, set in a scalloped green calyx. The straight green stem below carries two green leaves with yellow veins and gold flecks along its length. Transparent background.

The tub's staves rise higher behind them and the water inside is pale blue. Cut from the bas-de-page scene of the recto; the background is transparent.

crouching-gray-cat.description: A dark gray cat crouches low on a patch of green grass, its body stretched to the right and its head turned toward the viewer with round gold eyes and pricked ears; its long, faintly banded tail curls back along the left. A dark mouse hangs from its mouth, the thin black tail trailing on the grass. The fur is painted in fine pale strokes; the grass patch is streaked green with gold speckling and is cut flat along the bottom. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Labors (recto)

elongated-red-gray-leaf-scroll-with-blue.description: A very long, thin horizontal ornament. At the centre a round blue bud is held between two petal collars, red on the left and grey on the right. From the collars two tapering leaves stretch outward to a point, a grey one to the left and a red one to the right, each with a fine gold edge line and a curled tip. Transparent background.

elongated-red-gray-leaf-scroll-with-blue.title: Thin red and grey leaf spindle with blue bud

embracing-nude-couple-with-raised-fist.description: Two nude figures with curly red-gold hair embrace standing. A man at the left, seen from behind, cups the back of the woman's head with his right hand; the woman at the right faces him, her left arm raised high with a clenched fist and her other hand on his shoulder. Pale pink flesh with brown outlines and bluish shadows; the feet rest on the ground line of the scene and are cut flat there. Cut from the bas-de-page scene of the recto; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Labors (recto)

A wooden pail with gold hoops stands under the table. Transparent background.

A long green stem runs straight to the right and carries two rounded green leaves near its right end, one above and one below, pale-veined with black outlines. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.

large-blue-flower-with-drooping-petals.description: A large deep blue flower stands upright at the top; three rounded petals with gold anthers rise at the back, and the outer petals fold over and droop down on either side, with pale blue highlights and black outlines. It sits on a green calyx above a long straight stem, from whose foot two long narrow green leaves sweep upward on either side, teal and dark green with cream hatching. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.

large-red-flower-and-bud-on-branching-st.description: A large red carnation with fringed, gold-streaked petals at the right and a smaller carnation bud with dark red fringed petals in a green calyx at the lower centre, both on a green stem that arcs in from the lower left and carries about seven small green leaves. Transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Ornamental Border with Carnations, a Thistle, and a Cook Ladling Soup (verso)

large-red-flower-and-bud-on-branching-st.title: Red carnation with a bud on a branching stem

large-red-tulip-with-blue-sepals-and-sid.description: A tall red flower of pointed, finely striped petals, closed like a tulip with a small green tip, rises from a scalloped deep blue calyx with pale striping. A long green stem descends, with a smaller red bud on a side shoot to the right and two large lobed green leaves, one at the upper left and one at the lower right, teal with cream hatching and dark green edges. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Peasant (verso)

large-red-tulip-with-blue-sepals-and-sid.quality: AI-assisted extraction; no pixel is fully opaque (alpha peaks at 253, invisible in use).

middle-two-green-leaf-curved-twig.description: Two long green leaves with gold-edged margins and pale vein strokes cross at a short stem, the upper one pointing up to the right and the lower one hanging down to the left with a curled tip. A short twig with a gold tip sticks out to the left at the crossing. Transparent background.

middle-two-green-leaf-curved-twig.title: Two crossed green leaves on a short twig
usage_notes: The middle of three sprigs stacked in one margin of the recto, between the red flower and the oval bud.
The verso carries the same leaf-pair motif as upright-paired-green-leaves.

paired-pale-yellow-flowers-on-green-leaf.description: Two pale yellow five-petalled flowers with orange centres, seen from the front, sit at the left on thin green stems, one above the other. The stems join a branch at the right that carries two large curling green leaves, one sweeping up and one down, teal with cream hatching on one side and dark green on the other, with dark outlines. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.

pale-pleated-fan-flower-on-curved-green-.description: A pale yellow-ochre carnation opens as a pleated fan to the right from pointed green sepals; its green stem curves in from the left with gold flecks along it and carries two long green leaves, one curling upward and one hanging below. pale-yellow-daisy-on-leafy-stem.description: A pale yellow daisy with many rounded petals and a red centre dotted with yellow is seen from the front at the left. Its green stem runs to the right and ends in a curl, carrying three lobed, serrated green leaves with pale vein strokes, two above the stem and one below. Wide horizontal piece on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Ornamental Border with Flowers and Squirrel (verso)

Its green stem loops up over the flower and runs down to the right, carrying three tiers of paired green leaves with dark outlines and pale vein strokes. Tall piece on a transparent background.

peasant-carrying-large-wicker-basket.description: A bearded man in a gray tunic with gold edging, a gray cap, blue hose and black shoes walks to the left, bent forward under a tall rectangular wicker basket strapped to his back. He leans on a brown staff in his right hand and holds a second brown rod level in his left. He walks on a patch of green grass, cut flat below. Opaque gouache with dark outlines; the background is transparent.

pointed-blue-red-flower-with-long-green-.description: An upright flower: a green pointed tip rises above blue pointed petals streaked in white, which emerge from a red fringed corolla hatched in cream. Black outlines; transparent background.

red-four-petaled-flower-on-curved-stem.description: A large red flower seen from the front at the right, with four broad notched petals edged in dark red, each with gold striping, around a pale pink centre. From the left a long green stem curves in, carrying two broad leaves that curl up at the left and down at the lower right, pale green on one side of the midrib and dark on the other, with cream hatching and a black outline. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Labors (recto)

red-four-petaled-flower-on-curved-stem.quality: Ragged cut with a thin gold-ground fringe along the edges.

usage_notes: The flower head alone crops to a near-square rosette; the stem and leaves make it a corner piece that fills the lower right of the leaf.

red-gray-radial-flower-on-green-leaf-spr.description: At the top a red bowl-shaped flower with cream striping, a gray-blue folded inner petal and a brown curling bract behind it, sits on a green and cream collar. Below, a thin stem runs down with three large green leaves, pale-veined with black outlines, and a small gray-tipped green bud on a side shoot at the right. Opaque gouache with a gold-ground fringe; the brown bract at the top left and the leaf at the right are clipped by the page edge. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Labors (recto)

red-gray-radial-flower-on-green-leaf-spr.quality: The brown bract at the top left and the right-hand leaf are cut flat where the painting met the edge of the leaf, and the cut carries a gold-ground fringe.

red-scalloped-flower-on-long-green-leave.description: A red carnation with five fringed, scalloped petals marked by pale radiating lines fills the right half, seen from the front. Its green stem curves down to the left and carries two long, narrow green leaves with pale vein strokes, one rising up and one lying along the bottom, meeting at a short stalk at the lower left. Wide horizontal piece on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Ornamental Border with Flowers and Squirrel (verso)

red-scalloped-flower-on-long-green-leave.quality: The stalk touches the bottom edge of the master at the lower left, and the figure interior sits at alpha 253 rather than 255, invisible in use.

red-umbrella-flower-on-two-leaved-stem.description: A red flower shaped like a bell or umbrella, with gold streaks down its skirt and a small gold tuft at the top, hangs over a green calyx of pointed sepals. A tall straight green stem runs down with two rounded green leaves, one at the right and one lower at the left, teal with cream hatching and dark green edges. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.

rose-and-blue-bud-on-curved-stem.description: A rounded rose-pink bud with a small deep blue pointed petal at its upper left sits in two green sepals at the top. A green stem curves down to the right and back, carrying two pairs of rounded green leaves, pale green with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green with a black outline on the other. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.

rose-and-blue-bud-on-curved-stem.quality: Ragged cut with a thin gold-ground fringe along the edges.

rose-blue-and-gold-layered-flower.description: A wide fantastical flower built in layers, a rose-pink striped base petal, two deep blue petals scrolling outward into spirals at either side, a tall brown and gold folded petal in the centre and two spiky red and gold petals flanking it. Three rounded pale green sepals sit below, and a short dark stem carries two pointed green leaves, pale-veined, spreading left and right. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Psalter and Prayerbook: Calendar Page with Labors (recto)

rose-blue-and-gold-layered-flower.quality: Ragged cut with a thin gold-ground fringe along the edges.

rose-fan-flower-with-small-red-bud.description: A crimson fan-shaped flower with fine striping opens at the top, held in small green sepals. A long green stem descends and branches, carrying four pairs of rounded green leaves with pale veins, a small red bud with a blue petal on a side shoot at the right about a third of the way down, and a blue and rose bud hanging at the very bottom. Opaque gouache; the thin stems have small gaps and a gold-ground fringe. The background is transparent.

seated-embracing-couple.description: A woman in a blue gown with gold edging and a red hat sits on the ground at the left, seen from behind in three-quarter view, and embraces a man with golden hair in a red doublet with gold trim, green and blue striped hose and black shoes, who sits close behind her with his legs stretched to the right; their faces touch. Cut from the bas-de-page scene of the recto; the background is transparent.

seated-embracing-couple.title: Seated embracing couple

seated-red-squirrel-with-bushy-tail.description: A reddish-brown squirrel sits upright on a small patch of green grass, seen from the side and facing right, with both forepaws raised in front of its chest. Its large bushy tail curls up behind the back to above the head, and the ears stand up with pale tufts. The fur is modelled in fine dark strokes with white highlights. Transparent background.

sideways-red-blue-gray-flower-on-scroll.description: A flower lying on its side points to the lower right, with a red striped lobe at the tip, a gray curling petal above it and three small round blue petals at its base. From the upper left a green stem runs down to it, carrying two large green leaves that curl up and down, teal with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green on the other, with dark outlines. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.

three-couples-in-garden-under-painted-ar.description: The bas-de-page scene of the recto, a wide strip under three painted arches (red, blue, red) on blue and red columns with gold capitals. At the left a seated couple in blue and red embrace; in the middle a couple sits in a wooden tub sharing a goblet, a gray jug on the ground before it; at the right a nude couple embraces, one fist raised. Behind them green trees, a blue sky and pale buildings at the right, on a sandy ground with pebbles and grass. Opaque, with a thin red-brown rule along the top and bottom; transparent outside.
